result.topic_en: A table of quadratic residues: rows are the primes 3 to 181 and columns the primes 367 to 503, with small circles linked by lines marking the cells where the row prime is a quadratic residue of the column prime.

methods.what: Tabulation of quadratic residues: a mark in a cell records that the row prime is a quadratic residue modulo the column prime. Marks are linked by lines into a graphical pattern.
methods.quote: [Grid of small circles connected by horizontal and vertical lines marking entries; no further numerals or text in the body]
